# focus.meet

> Institutional video meetings for participants aged 18 and older, with account-based invitations and AI-assisted moderation. Advertising is disabled. Audio transcription and moderation involve cloud processing; AI may make mistakes.

## Pages
- [Home](https://focusmeeting.lovable.app/): Product overview
- [Meeting guide](https://focusmeeting.lovable.app/meeting-guide): Original institutional meeting guidance
- [Privacy](https://focusmeeting.lovable.app/privacy): Processing, planned retention limits and contact information
- [Safety](https://focusmeeting.lovable.app/safety): Conduct and reporting
